page: Microsoft Azure NV8ads_V710_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an x86_64 AMD processor under Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Graphical and compute acceleration is delivered through a fractional AMD V710 GPU allocation comprising approximately one-third of a physical GPU and offering 8 GB of dedicated VRAM.

Local storage consists of a bundled 550 GB NVMe SSD, providing low-latency temporary capacity for active datasets and caching. The platform also supports Premium Storage for expandable persistent block devices. Networking configurations do not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring virtual network routing or address allocation for external ingress and egress.

The fractional GPU partitioning model enables cost efficiency by allowing workloads to access dedicated GPU capabilities without paying for an entire physical accelerator. The NV8ads_V710_v5 is suited for virtual desktop infrastructure, interactive 3D visualization, lightweight machine learning inference, video processing, and graphics-accelerated engineering applications.
description: Microsoft Azure NV8ads_V710_v5 is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring an x86_64 AMD processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs, 32.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU), and a fractional AMD V710 GPU partition offering 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Fast temporary local storage is integrated with a bundled 550 GB NVMe SSD, alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage for persistent volumes. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. By dividing a physical GPU into fractional slices, this server profile balances hardware density and cost efficiency for accelerated workloads that do not require full-die GPU access. The NV8ads_V710_v5 is suitable for virtual workstations, cloud desktop deployments, moderate 3D rendering, and lightweight inference pipelines.
